portfolio_families.name: DOPRI5 embedded 5(4)
portfolio_families.previous_reason: RHS-only path avoids all Jacobian, matrix and Newton work; selected nonstiff smooth forward identity-mass scope has actual-error evidence.
portfolio_families.previous_evidence_summary: 90 configurations / 360 runs; local native RODAS comparison 2.73–8.93x at sampled cap 1e-6; stiff negative control requires 186085 RHS calls and is about277x slower than RODAS.
portfolio_families.constructive_reinterpretation: RHS-only explicit integration is the genuine fully derivative-free general smooth branch. It also supplies a cheap control against speculative structure.
portfolio_families.admissibility: Smooth nonstiff RHS; identity mass; observed acceptance/effort, not a stiffness label inferred from a single secant.
portfolio_families.mechanism_or_formula: No Jacobian/JVP/Newton; FSAL gives 6 fresh RHS after the first accepted derivative.
portfolio_families.adaptive_selection_contract: Use existing persistent session, reset FSAL only on state/model changes; rising rejection/work triggers a bounded optional implicit pilot.
portfolio_families.next_discriminating_experiment: Use slow, fast oscillatory, stiff-decay and discontinuous-regime controls; record total calls and final/retained-grid error.

measurable_acceptance_contract.robustness: Record success/refusal/numerical-failure/fatal-input separately. A rescue is useful if it completes a predeclared case where the comparator fails, without increasing error beyond E; no universal stability conclusion follows.

portfolio_families.name: Affine quotient Lawson / exact harmonic endpoint
portfolio_families.previous_reason: Constant affine and harmonic structure admits cheap entire-function actions; that structure is user evidence, not inferred from arbitrary RHS samples.
portfolio_families.previous_evidence_summary: Prior affine/full-RHS ratios4.36x,22.71x,1.58x on selected stiff/rapid/shared128 cases; losses4.25x zero,5.09x slow and44.58x generic forcing prohibit automatic adoption. Latest LP01 timings remain inconclusive.

portfolio_families.admissibility: Declared affine forcing, damped rotation/low-degree annihilator, fixed coefficients over window.

portfolio_families.next_discriminating_experiment: Near ω=0 and resonance, shared blocks, long phase, huge damping/input; compare strongest closed-form reference.

portfolio_families.name: Parallel causal Picard / residual-first schedules
portfolio_families.previous_reason: Serial forward is faster on all seven eligible groups. Two threads show no material1.2x gain on the tested cheap RHS workload.
portfolio_families.previous_evidence_summary: 84 bitwise pairs,42 same-configuration thread settings; no general threading speed gain.
portfolio_families.constructive_reinterpretation: Cheap-RHS losses do not settle expensive independent stage callbacks or accelerator batching. Restrict the question to measured span crossover.
portfolio_families.admissibility: Same frozen iterate for parallel stage RHS; causal lower dependency and bounded residual convergence.
portfolio_families.mechanism_or_formula: Stage i is exact after at most i+1 propagation rounds in exact arithmetic; seed stage0 reduces further updates to s−1.
portfolio_families.adaptive_selection_contract: Require explicit workers and cost model predicting q·wave_cost+barriers<serial_cost; cap q and fall back to forward.
portfolio_families.next_discriminating_experiment: Artificial delay is a scheduler calibration only; use actual expensive RHS and no-delay negative control; charge extra RHS and pool setup.

additional_mechanisms.name: Primary decomposition and confluent finite jets
additional_mechanisms.formula: For q=∏(x−λ_i)^m_i, coprime CRT gives K[x]/q ≅ ∏K[ε]/ε^m_i. Preserve each derivative jet through root coalescence.
additional_mechanisms.constructive_benefit: Scalar coefficient work may be shared; it does not delete independent amplitudes. Compute stable entire/divided-difference limits instead of subtracting close modal values.

additional_mechanisms.discriminating_case: Distinct/near-coincident/exactly-coincident roots with Jordan blocks; compare stable sinhc/expm1 formulas.
additional_mechanisms.status: historical theorem reused; new general compiler not implemented by inventory

additional_mechanisms.name: Involution-even/odd computation sharing
additional_mechanisms.formula: If S²=I and SAS=−A, even powers commute withS and odd powers anticommute; Π±=(I±S)/2 retain both sectors.
additional_mechanisms.constructive_benefit: Evaluate common even coefficient functions once and recover odd signs; symmetry reduces duplicate transcendental work rather than deleting odd state.
additional_mechanisms.adaptive_contract: Require declared symmetry identity and parameter compatibility; model changes invalidate grouping.

additional_mechanisms.formula: f(y_ref+Uz)=Ug(z), JU=UJ_r imply full causal stages K_i=Uk_i^r by induction with common invertible W.
additional_mechanisms.constructive_benefit: Replace n-factorization by r-factorization while original target equality holds; lift and physical norm still cost O(nr).

additional_mechanisms.status: historical derived theorem, scoped native pieces exist

additional_mechanisms.name: Local reaction ideals and rationalized roots
additional_mechanisms.formula: Eliminate u from u+x=Q and x−x0−a u(1−x)=0; physical root x=2(x0+aQ)/(1+a(Q+1)+sqrt(D)), D≥1 under u0≥0,0≤x0≤1,a≥0.
additional_mechanisms.constructive_benefit: Nonlinear local resolvent without runtime derivative or Newton; use as predictor/preconditioner in high-order target.
additional_mechanisms.adaptive_contract: Check denominator/domain/physical interval and original balance; fall back near failed conditions; never inherit order5 from backward Euler.
additional_mechanisms.discriminating_case: Large a, depleted species, cancellation and overflow controls; full target accuracy after correction.
additional_mechanisms.status: historical formula and24probes reused; wider generic source generation proposed

additional_mechanisms.name: Rational jets, chart/cofactor transport and fast initial impulse
additional_mechanisms.formula: For y=x²(w+1/κ), reconstruction error is bounded by (2|x|r_x+r_x²)|w+1/κ|+(|x|+r_x)²r_w plus represented-center error.
additional_mechanisms.constructive_benefit: Resolve stiff transverse dynamics analytically in a regular chart and retain nonzero fast data; physical defect certifies useful accuracy.
